integrity: Analytical argument and supplementary finite arithmetic checks are provided. Independent audit and publication-priority validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional Brownian particles with independent fixed-size uniform reset batches and m_N/N tending to a positive limit; no subextensive-batch limit, confinement, interacting-particle statement, or uniform finite-population extreme-tail claim. Prior two-point correlation and common-age results are credited.
title: Random Gaussian-mixture limits and a q-product energy law for batch-reset Brownian gases
